recommendation.rationale: No false merge on fixed holdout for the selected lexical variant; lower scores remain manual review candidates.

read immutable document revisions and rawItem provenance

create new cluster links in a new algorithm-version namespace
retain old cluster links until review and record supersession
route low-confidence and verbatim_only candidates to manual review
compare old/new cluster membership and provide rollback by disabling the new version
